ios.desc:
Remember the first time you deadlifted your bodyweight? 

What about when you finally hit that 2-plate bench? 

Those moments define your journey - don't let them disappear in your camera roll.

NEVER LOSE A LIFTING MILESTONE

- Automatically organize PR videos by date, weight and lift
- Watch your strength journey unfold from day one

YOUR PERSONAL LIFTING MUSEUM

- Create a timeline of your biggest achievements
- Add personal notes about how each lift felt
- See exactly how much stronger you've become

BUILT FOR THE LONG GAME

- Smart compression saves 90% storage space
- Organize by session, date, or lift type

Six months from now, when you're struggling with motivation, nothing beats watching your first big lift and remembering why you started.

DISCLAIMERS

In order to access the application, you will need to acquire a pro membership.
